claims.text: AC 107-2A states that when a hazard occurs, 'Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft'; if the connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.

claims.text: According to the manual, Failsafe RTH is activated if the remote controller signal is lost for more than three seconds, provided the Home Point is recorded and the compass is functioning normally, and the aircraft will retrace its route home.
claims.quote: Failsafe RTH will be automatically activated if the remote controller signal is lost for more than three seconds.
conditions: remote controller signal lost for more than three seconds

claims.text: When RTH is triggered, the aircraft will ascend to the pre-set RTH attitude and then fly to the Home Point, and will hover 0.7 m above ground waiting for user confirmation.
claims.quote: The aircraft will hover 0.7 m above ground and wait for confirmation from the user.
conditions: hover 0.7 m above ground awaiting user confirmation

claims.text: When communications are lost the UA would normally enter a 'Failsafe RTH' mode, but it could not return home due to the wind and limited pitch attitude.
claims.quote: When communications are lost the UA would normally enter a ‘Failsafe RTH’ mode, but it could not return home due to the wind and limited pitch attitude.

claims.text: The UA drifted beyond visual line of sight and communication was lost which meant that a recovery was no longer possible.
claims.quote: The UA drifted beyond visual line of sight and communication was lost which meant that a recovery was no longer possible.

claims.text: RTH then appeared to engage but the aircraft did not move any closer.

claims.text: After communication was lost, the UA entered an auto-land mode but it was unable to avoid colliding with a wall.

text: FAA guidance says reestablish the control link and, if not possible, start emergency procedures; it notes loss-of-link hazards and requires preflight control-link procedures. The Matrice 210 V1 manual: Failsafe RTH triggers after three seconds of signal loss; the craft retraces home, then hovers 0.7 m above ground awaiting confirmation. Incident reports claim RTH activated but ineffective, wind or pitch prevented return, and auto-land led to a collision. Gaps: no verified evidence that Poole followed the procedures; Home Point status and wind conditions are unverified; model attribution is unclear.
